title: R' Yitzchak bar Halov
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Mentioned in [Chullin 99b](https://www.sefaria.org/Chullin.99b.11): Rabbi Ami would send cases to him because he ruled permissively, in the name of Rabbi Yehoshua ben Levi, on the ground that sinews do not impart flavor.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The linked Gemara names Rabbi Yitzchak ben Chalov (בן חלוב), where Hyman has bar Halov. [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=2181&lang=en) gives bar Chalov. Both sources have Rabbi Ami sending matters to Yitzchak.

Yitzchak ruled permissively in Rabbi Yehoshua ben Levi’s name. In the linked Gemara, Rabbi Ami disagreed, but the passage concludes in agreement with the permissive ruling that sinews do not impart flavor.
